facilityDetails.programFocus: Glen Haven Adult Day Program provides structured daytime activities, supervision, and support services for adults needing assistance during the day. These services typically include health monitoring, therapeutic activities, social and recreational programming, meals, snacks, personal care assistance, and medication management.

The program serves older adults with dementia, disabilities, or those recovering from illness.
